purpose: Sanitized evidence for on-demand rendering and complete asynchronous publication material; not a school discovery or article-validation acceptance claim.
privacy: No raw HTML, HTTP headers, response payloads, cookies, keys, user database content or machine paths are included.
root_causes: Static navigation and convincing dated notification labels caused the HTTP async shell to be called usable while all destinations were placeholders.
DOMContentLoaded returned before native public data requests populated publication regions.
The first fix waited for dated cards but omitted remaining column-header destinations; it stopped after three of five asynchronous regions completed.
Old cached HTTP observations could replay the shell instead of dispatching a rendered read; failed partial DOMs could be cached as completed material.

isolation.network_policy: Independent limiter; official host only, public-address validation; images/fonts/media blocked. Native scripts/CSS/XHR allowed. No access-control bypass.
isolation.production_execution: Production classify_result, coordinator fetch/render, BrowserRuntime submit/navigate/content-wait; only browser launch channel and official-host network admission were isolated.
isolation.repeat_reads: One diagnostic HTTP+Edge comparison, one initial production failure, one final production verification following that new failure; both production reads reused the same retained HTTP.

first_production_attempt_failed.reason: Only 21 actual long-link occurrences arrived; two column-header links were still root placeholders. This attempt is retained as failed evidence.

retained_real_DOM_reclassification_no_ne.scope: Retained actual official DOM replay only, no new network, no AI

audit_correction.reason: The verifier incorrectly required 29 DISTINCT title/URL pairs. Actual DOM has 29 occurrences and 27 distinct pairs because 2 pinned items appear in two regions. Correct comparison preserves occurrence counts. No new network execution.

controlled_checks.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 -m pytest tests/test_dynamic_material_acquisition.py tests/test_acquisition.py tests/test_browser_runtime.py tests/test_http_transport.py tests/test_acquisition_callers.py tests/test_source_validation.py tests/test_discovery_fetch_policy.py tests/test_fetch_evidence_resume.py -q --disable-warnings
controlled_checks.coverage: Static/async pages, attachments/empty lists, access/challenges/login, cache reclassification, partial-DOM isolation, article identity conflicts and retry policy. No real school read or model request in these tests.
Delayed native XHR, independently delayed column destination, failed XHR with explicit incomplete material. All navigation is to a temporary loopback fixture.
After integrating the publication=feed argument, caller/discovery regressions still pass. This set overlaps the 150-test set and is not added to it as distinct tests.

measured_parameters.evidence: Final real read completed in 24.333 seconds without increasing the deadline; local failed load returned typed incomplete material at its configured 1-second test deadline.
Retained real HTTP triggers browser; intermediate partial DOM remains incomplete; final 29 occurrences and all five column destinations are available.

measured_parameters.parameter: Global/host read concurrency and host interval
measured_parameters.evidence: Isolated official run peak 1 and minimum start interval 1.000579799991101 seconds; no competing same-host task during this read.
The measured final HTML is 35,381 bytes. This sample does not establish behavior for every large dynamic page.
Neither was attempted; no universal claim about 985 universities follows from this page.

measured_parameters.parameter: AI accuracy/cost and full RUC source connection
measured_parameters.evidence: No model request or new source installation was executed; department ownership, column rules, article correspondence and daily updates are separate acceptance work.

limitations: 29 is the observed occurrence count on this exact page, not a universal completion threshold in program code.
Two pinned articles appear in two regions, leaving 27 distinct title/address pairs; each actual region occurrence is preserved in the comparison.
Column heading images with empty alternative text still require semantic observation; this check does not infer department names from image filenames.
When native data access fails, material stays incomplete and is not supplied to AI as a complete page. Access restrictions are not bypassed.
No full browser or local model was newly bundled; installer size is measured separately.
